enriched_activities.desc: Lie down on bed. Pull blanket over body. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow. Turn to right side. Pull blanket up. Change position. Stretch legs. Yawn. Turn over. Pull blanket. Sleep.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, washing face, brushing teeth and showering
enriched_activities.desc: Open eyes. Sit up on bed. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Turn on bathroom light. Turn on water heater. Turn on tap. Wet face. Apply soap to face. Rinse face. Turn off tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Spit. Turn on shower. Adjust water temperature. Step into shower. Wet body. Apply shampoo. Rinse hair. Apply body wash. Rinse body. Turn off shower. Step out. Pick up towel. Dry body. Dry hair. Wrap towel around body. Turn off light. Walk out of bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Preparing and eating breakfast, boiling water with the kettle and toasting bread
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out bread, butter, and jam. Close refrigerator. Place bread on counter. Open bread bag. Take out two slices of bread. Place slices in toaster. Press toaster lever down. Fill kettle with water. Turn on kettle. Pour hot water into mug. Add tea bag. Take toast from toaster. Spread butter on toast. Spread jam on toast. Sit at table. Eat toast and drink tea. Stand up. Place dishes in sink.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and packing work bag and laptop for the day
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into bedroom. Open wardrobe. Take out shirt. Take out pants. Close wardrobe. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Open drawer. Take out underwear. Put on underwear. Open bag. Place laptop in bag. Place charger in bag. Place notebook in bag. Place pen in bag. Zip bag. Pick up bag. Walk out of bedroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting to the nonprofit community center
enriched_activities.desc: Walk out of house. Lock door. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Bus arrives. Board bus. Swipe transit card. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Bus stops. Stand up. Walk to exit. Get off bus. Walk to community center. Enter building. Walk to office. Sit at desk.

enriched_activities.activity: Working at the community center: coordinating program logistics, emails and partner calls
enriched_activities.desc: Turn on computer. Open email client. Read emails. Reply to emails. Open calendar. Schedule meeting. Pick up phone. Dial number. Speak to partner. Write notes. Hang up phone. Open document. Type program logistics. Print document. Collect printout. File document. Open spreadsheet. Update data. Save file.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a lunch break near the community center
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to lunch place. Open door. Approach counter. Read menu. Order sandwich. Pay cashier. Receive sandwich. Walk to table. Sit down. Unwrap sandwich. Eat sandwich. Drink water. Wipe mouth with napkin. Stand up. Throw trash in bin. Walk back to community center. Enter building.

enriched_activities.activity: Working at the community center: running program sessions and planning upcoming community events
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to meeting room. Arrange chairs. Turn on projector. Open laptop. Connect laptop to projector. Greet participants. Start presentation. Speak to group. Answer questions. Hand out materials. Collect feedback forms. End session. Walk back to office. Sit at desk. Open event planning document. Write notes. Call venue. Confirm booking. Send confirmation email. Update event calendar.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting home from the community center
enriched_activities.desc: Walk out of community center. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Bus arrives. Board bus. Swipe transit card. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Bus stops. Stand up. Walk to exit. Get off bus. Walk to home. Unlock door. Enter house. Close door.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing hands and freshening up after the commute
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Wet hands. Apply soap. Rub hands together. Rinse hands. Turn off tap. Pick up towel. Dry hands. Splash water on face. Pat face dry. Turn off light. Walk out of bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking and eating dinner using the induction cooker
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables and chicken. Close refrigerator. Place vegetables on cutting board. Wash vegetables. Chop vegetables. Place pot on induction cooker. Turn on induction cooker. Add oil to pot. Add chicken. Stir chicken. Add vegetables. Stir vegetables. Add soy sauce. Stir. Turn off induction cooker. Place food on plate. Sit at table. Eat dinner and drink water. Stand up.

enriched_activities.activity: Clearing the table and washing dishes in the dishwasher
enriched_activities.desc: Pick up plates. Scrape leftovers into trash. Stack plates. Pick up glasses. Open dishwasher. Load plates into dishwasher. Load glasses into dishwasher. Load utensils into dishwasher. Add detergent. Close dishwasher. Turn on dishwasher. Pick up sponge. Wipe table. Wipe counters. Rinse sponge. Turn off kitchen light. Walk out of kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing and watching TV with the air conditioner on
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into living room. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Turn on air conditioner. Adjust air conditioner temperature. Sit on sofa. Change channel. Watch TV. Pick up phone. Check messages. Put down phone. Change channel. Watch TV. Go to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out drink. Close refrigerator. Return to living room. Sit on sofa. Drink. Watch TV.

enriched_activities.activity: Using the computer with the desk lamp to review program notes and plan tomorrow's tasks
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into bedroom. Turn on desk lamp. Open laptop. Turn on laptop. Open program notes file. Read notes. Type comments. Save file. Open calendar. Review tomorrow's schedule. Add tasks. Type notes. Close laptop. Turn off desk lamp. Stand up.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking an evening shower and getting ready for bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into bathroom. Turn on bathroom light. Turn on shower. Adjust water temperature. Step into shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Rinse body. Apply shampoo. Rinse hair. Turn off shower. Step out. Pick up towel. Dry body. Dry hair. Wrap towel around body. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Put on pajamas. Turn off light. Walk out of bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Reading and winding down with the fan on
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into bedroom. Turn on fan. Pick up book. Sit on bed. Open book. Read pages. Turn page. Read pages. Turn page. Close book. Place book on nightstand. Turn off fan. Lie down on bed. Pull blanket over body.
Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow. Pull blanket up. Sleep. Turn to right side. Stretch legs. Yawn. Pull blanket. Sleep. Turn to back. Sleep.
